# The OSINT Grid

> A structured index of public-records sources curated by The OSINT Vault for investigations, research, due diligence, compliance, journalism, and OSINT workflows.

## Primary resources

- [Repository README](README.md): Project purpose, use cases, roadmap, maintainer, and live tool reference.
- [Overview](docs/overview.md): Project scope, source categories, and future development direction.
- [Source schema](data/sources.schema.json): JSON schema for source records.
- [Source dataset](data/sources.json): Machine-readable source index.
- [Toolkit integration](TOOLKIT.md): Relationship to The OSINT Vault Toolkit.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Project version history.
- [Contributing guide](contributing.md): Contribution expectations and workflow.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): Security reporting guidance.
- [Code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Community standards.

## What this repository contains

- A machine-readable catalog of public-records sources.
- Source metadata fields including identifier, name, URL, category, jurisdiction, description, and operational status.
- Documentation for investigative and technical use.
- A version-controlled foundation for future API, validation, analytics, and CLI integrations.

## Source categories

- Corporate and business registries
- Property and land records
- Court and case lookup systems
- Licensing and permits
- Government directories
- Public databases
- International records

## Usage

Use `data/sources.json` together with `data/sources.schema.json` when consuming or validating records programmatically. Treat each linked source as an entry point for lawful research, and confirm current availability and terms directly with the source provider.

## Important notes

- The repository describes the OSINT Grid as a 4,500+ source project, but the currently committed `data/sources.json` should be treated as the authoritative dataset for this revision.
- Source availability, coverage, access requirements, and terms may change. Verify information before relying on it.
- This project is an index and documentation resource; it does not endorse unlawful access, harassment, privacy violations, or misuse of personal information.
